## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: P1 guarantees/clock/resource policy.

takeover/heartbeat/failure semantics, `IdempotencyCoordinator`, downstream capability model

- P4.4 — Встроить IdempotencyCoordinator, capability policy и crash/fencing gate: Supported fenced invoke path, capability policy, crash/fencing receipt and explicit residual boundaries.

sections.title: DoR (Definition of Ready)
sections.text:
- [x] D9 выбрал fenced acquire/CAS, три observer-состояния, coordinator capability и injected SQL.
- [x] P4/P3/P5/P6/P7/P8 ownership разведён; P4 не выбирает token consume, event-batch, spec revision, exports.
- [x] Lease clock (`:now`), expiry boundary, attempt/token monotonicity и completed-only cleanup заданы в `@plan/knowledge/research-P4-design.json`.
- [x] Migration: unfenced `complete(request)` снимается с supported path; stale worker не может complete новой версии.
- [ ] P1.4/P1.5 execution outputs существуют и digest-qualified; до этого P4 items dependency-not-ready, а не RED.

sections.title: Scope Included
sections.text:
Acquire/in-progress/completed storage; request fingerprint collision; opaque fencing token/attempt;
heartbeat; lease expiry/takeover; CAS complete/fail; deterministic result replay; retention of
completed rows; native-key/read-before-write/compensatable/at-most-once-only/unknown capability
policy; ambiguous failure handling; PHP/Dart parity и storage contract tests; wiring supported
invoke path through `IdempotencyCoordinator`.

sections.title: Scope Excluded
sections.text:
Exactly-once claim; orchestration/saga engine; automatic retries для unknown high-risk tool;
downstream product-specific compensation logic; editing `spec/revisions/2026-08/**`; P3 token
consume; P5 event journal/epoch; final package exports; public release; live owner-database
migration.

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.text:
P1.4 and P1.5 are execution predecessors of P4.1. P4.4 waits on P4.2 and P4.3. D2 forbids
execution of every P4 item until P1–P10 detail and whole-plan design audit are GREEN.
Внутри P4 порядок: P4.1 → (P4.2 ∥ P4.3) → P4.4. P8 добавляет mutation/fuzz depth после
базовой корректности.
